$comment: wave3-optimization §1.20 (C-20; REQ-W3-045, 047): the organisation's Karvey repositories by local path. Default location {ops_repo or spec_repo}/docs/spec/portfolio.json. The view reads files only: `clone` is information, never fetched or cloned.

path.x-karvey-note: a local clone: absolute, or relative to the portfolio file's directory; checked before any read (no control or shell characters)

clone.x-karvey-note: where the repository can be cloned from: shown, never used

owner.x-karvey-note: a role (the team that answers for the repository), not a person's name
